data.name: CID30_Intro
data.value: These are the open-source libraries used in this app.

data.name: CID02_Info1
data.value: More and more organisations require you to add an ID check to the DigiD app.

data.name: CID02_Info2
data.value: This gives organisations more certainty that the right person is logging in and can access personal data.

data.name: CID02_Info3
data.value: During the ID check, you scan the chip on your identity document. The app checks whether the document is valid and belongs to you.

data.name: CID02_Info4
data.value: After scanning with the CheckID app, the ID check is added to your DigiD app. The ID check is valid for one year.

data.name: CID02_Info5
data.value: The app checks if the identity document is valid and yours.

data.name: CID02_Info6
data.value: No personal data is stored on this device or in the DigiD app.

data.name: CID02_Info7
data.value: No personal data is stored on this device or in the DigiD app.

data.name: CID01_Message
data.value: With the CheckID app you can perform the ID check for the DigiD app on another device. DigiD uses this to verify that your identity document is valid and belongs to you. The ID check is valid for one year.

data.name: CID27_Intro

data.name: FM08_Body

data.name: CID31_Intro
data.value: We pay a lot of attention to the accessibility and user-friendliness of the Check-ID app. The aim is to develop the app in a way that it can be used by anyone. That is why we adhere to the requirements for digital accessibility when developing the app.

data.name: CID25_Intro
data.value: If you have a question about this app, please contact DigiD.
